answer: Each attempt carries 210 separate visits, each one billed $26 at the door, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. To join, a name must pass Sworn harpsichord maker hall oath, which works because an oath makers swear before string witnesses. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Every lagoon is counted once. One sonnet, one entry. The whisper is on the docket.
